purpose: Determine when production changes stay inside one canonical model and when separate generation or layout identities are required.

rules.when: Market identity remains continuous and changes are construction, dimensions, equipment, interior, propulsion or refresh changes that can be accurately scoped by year without misleading buyers.
The same marketed model name reappears after a production gap or material redesign and one flat record would create ambiguous or misleading specifications.
The builder marketed materially different layouts or configurations as distinct versions and buyers need them separately searchable.
Evidence cannot establish whether a change crosses the identity threshold; keep the candidate unresolved rather than forcing a merge or split.
